# Sizland

> Invisible, censorship-resistant infrastructure for the global remote workforce.

Sizland is the decentralized operating system for sovereign remote workers. It provides client-side Decentralized Identity (DiD), a multi-chain wallet factory, and unified access so people can own their reputation, settle across chains, and work without leaving a digital trace.

Website: https://www.siz.land/

## Status (2026)

- Phase 1 Foundation: Complete (June 2026). Core DiD infrastructure, Sizland Identity Protocol, multi-chain wallet factory layer, and production-ready secure API.
- Phase 2 Reputation Engine: In progress. ERP automated bridges, signed credential generation, decentralized score computation on SizChain X, and SIZ token staking.
- Phase 3 Scale & Sovereignty: Planned. Stablecoin milestone escrow, multi-chain payment factories, sovereign data indexing, and reputation-backed DeFi.

## Core architecture

- Decentralized Identity (DiD) — non-custodial, client-side
- Multi-chain wallet factory (Algorand, Base, BNB Chain, Sui, TON)
- Blockchain ERP and sovereign reputation
